units.source_text: 比毛线还细的麻纱，若缺少雪天的天然潮湿，就很难办了。

en.t: Hemp thread finer than wool yarn would be very hard to handle without the natural dampness of snowy weather.

units.source_text: 阴冷的季节对它似乎最合适。

en.t: A cold and damp season seemed to suit it best.

units.source_text: 古时有这样一种说法：三九寒天织出来的麻纱，三伏天穿上令人觉得特别凉爽，这是由于阴阳自然的关系。

en.t: There was an old saying that hemp thread woven in the bitter cold of midwinter felt especially cool when worn in the hottest days of summer, because of the natural relationship between yin and yang.
